description: Header file defining the PatchCommandThread class, which manages asynchronous creation and release of audio patch commands in Android's audio framework. It includes nested classes for command data and listener interfaces, and declares methods for thread control and command handling.

classes.name: PatchCommandThread
classes.description: Manages asynchronous patch commands in a dedicated thread.

classes.name: PatchCommandListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to patch command events.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents a command with type and associated data.

classes.name: CreateAudioPatchData
classes.description: Holds data for create audio patch command.

classes.name: ReleaseAudioPatchData
classes.description: Holds data for release audio patch command.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for patch command events.

methods.name: createAudioPatch
methods.description: Queues a command to create an audio patch.

methods.name: releaseAudioPatch
methods.description: Queues a command to release an audio patch.

methods.name: threadLoop
methods.description: Main loop of the thread processing commands.

methods.name: createAudioPatchCommand
methods.description: Creates a command to create an audio patch.

methods.name: releaseAudioPatchCommand
methods.description: Creates a command to release an audio patch.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the thread for processing.
